<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1.05" border="10"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="mmfISNZYDzgNCgEbFh2M"> <mxGraphModel dx="2049" dy="1193" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml class-diagram
title Class diagram tổng: BrewLite (TV7)

skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam titleFontColor #1F3864
skinparam titleFontSize 18
skinparam ArrowColor #444444
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundCorner 8
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam classFontSize 13
skinparam classAttributeFontSize 11
skinparam classStereotypeFontColor #555555
skinparam nodesep 50
skinparam ranksep 60
hide empty methods
hide circle

' Màu theo người phụ trách: thân lớp, viền, tiêu đề
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor<<TV1_TV2>> #F3F8FE
 BorderColor<<TV1_TV2>> #4A6FA5
 HeaderBackgroundColor<<TV1_TV2>> #CFE0F7
 BackgroundColor<<TV3>> #F4FBF4
 BorderColor<<TV3>> #5BA55B
 HeaderBackgroundColor<<TV3>> #CDEBCD
 BackgroundColor<<TV4>> #FEF8EF
 BorderColor<<TV4>> #D98E2B
 HeaderBackgroundColor<<TV4>> #FBDDB0
 BackgroundColor<<TV5>> #FAF5FD
 BorderColor<<TV5>> #8E5BB5
 HeaderBackgroundColor<<TV5>> #E3CFF0
 BackgroundColor<<TV6>> #FDF4F4
 BorderColor<<TV6>> #C25B5B
 HeaderBackgroundColor<<TV6>> #F5C9C9
 BackgroundColor<<TV7>> #FFFCEB
 BorderColor<<TV7>> #B58A1B
 HeaderBackgroundColor<<TV7>> #FFEC99
}

enum Role <<TV7>> {
 CUSTOMER
 STAFF
}

enum DiscountType <<TV3>> {
 PERCENT
 FIXED_AMOUNT
}

enum OrderStatus <<TV6>> {
 PENDING
 PAID
 PAYMENT_FAILED
 PREPARING
 READY
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
}

enum PaymentStatus <<TV5>> {
 PAID
 FAILED
}

enum PaymentMethod <<TV5>> {
 MOCK_WALLET
 MOCK_CARD
}

class User <<TV7>> {
 - id : Int
 - email : String
 - passwordHash : String
 - name : String
 - role : Role
 - loyaltyPoints : Int
 - createdAt : DateTime
 + verifyPassword(plain : String) : Boolean
 + hasRole(role : Role) : Boolean
}

class Category <<TV1_TV2>> {
 - id : Int
 - name : String
 - description : String
 + getProducts() : List<Product>
}

class Product <<TV1_TV2>> {
 - id : Int
 - name : String
 - description : String
 - price : Int
 - imageUrl : String
 - stock : Int
 - categoryId : Int
 - version : Int
 + isAvailable() : Boolean
 + updateStock(quantity : Int) : void
 + updatePrice(price : Int) : void
}

class ProductSize <<TV1_TV2>> {
 - id : Int
 - name : String
 - additionalPrice : Int
 + getPrice() : Int
}

class Topping <<TV1_TV2>> {
 - id : Int
 - name : String
 - price : Int
 - stock : Int
 + isAvailable() : Boolean
}

class Promotion <<TV3>> {
 - id : Int
 - code : String
 - description : String
 - discountType : DiscountType
 - discountValue : Int
 - maxDiscountAmount : Int
 - minOrderValue : Int
 - startsAt : DateTime
 - expiresAt : DateTime
 - usageLimit : Int
 - usedCount : Int
 - isActive : Boolean
}

class Order <<TV4>> {
 - id : Int
 - userId : Int
 - total : Int
 - status : OrderStatus
 - promotionId : Int
 - discountAmount : Int
 - createdAt : DateTime
 - updatedAt : DateTime
 + createOrder(userId : Int, items : OrderItem[], promotionCode : String) : Order
 + cancelOrder() : void
 + calculateTotal() : Int
 + transitionStatus(newStatus : OrderStatus) : void
}

class OrderItem <<TV4>> {
 - id : Int
 - orderId : Int
 - productId : Int
 - quantity : Int
 - price : Int
 - sizeId : Int
 - toppingIds : Int[]
 - note : String
 + getSubtotal() : Int
}

class Payment <<TV5>> {
 - id : Int
 - orderId : Int
 - idempotencyKey : String
 - amount : Int
 - method : PaymentMethod
 - status : PaymentStatus
 - transactionId : String
 - createdAt : DateTime
 + processPayment(dto : CreatePaymentDto, idempotencyKey : String) : Payment
 + validateAmount(orderTotal : Int, payAmount : Int) : Boolean
 + executeMockGateway(method : PaymentMethod, amount : Int) : GatewayResult
}

class LoyaltyTransaction <<TV6>> {
 - id : Int
 - userId : Int
 - orderId : Int
 - points : Int
 - createdAt : DateTime
}

' --- Quan hệ và multiplicity ---
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Order : đặt >
User \"1\" -- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : tích điểm >
Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem : gồm >
Order \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Payment : thanh toán bằng >
Order \"1\" -- \"0..1\" LoyaltyTransaction : phát sinh điểm >
Promotion \"0..1\" -- \"0..*\" Order : áp dụng cho >
Product \"1\" -- \"0..*\" OrderItem : có trong >
Category \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Product : chứa >
Product \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ProductSize : có kích thước >
Product \"0..*\" -- \"0..*\" Topping : cho phép chọn >
OrderItem \"0..*\" -- \"0..1\" ProductSize : chọn size >
OrderItem \"0..*\" -- \"0..*\" Topping : chọn topping >

' --- Thuộc tính dùng enum ---
User ..> Role
Promotion ..> DiscountType
Order ..> OrderStatus
Payment ..> PaymentStatus
Payment ..> PaymentMethod

legend right
 |= Màu |= Người phụ trách |
 |<#CFE0F7> | TV1, TV2 |
 |<#CDEBCD> | TV3 |
 |<#FBDDB0> | TV4 |
 |<#E3CFF0> | TV5 |
 |<#F5C9C9> | TV6 |
 |<#FFEC99> | TV7 |
endlegend
@enduml
